# Alakhsimar Singh

> Software engineer, machine learning researcher, freelance full-stack developer,
> and graphic designer. Technical Development Program Associate on the OIS DevOps
> team at Optum (UnitedHealth Group) since July 2026. B.Tech Computer Science
> Engineering, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar
> (2022-2026, CGPA 8.26).

Alakhsimar Singh builds production software, conducts machine learning research
in neuroimaging and computer vision, takes on freelance full-stack client work,
and does graphic/video editing design work. This site is organized into four
lenses, each a distinct profile of the same person.

## Tech

- [Tech profile](/tech): Software engineering at Optum and the Smart Notes Platform project.
- [Optum, full-time](/tech): Technical Development Program Associate, OIS DevOps team, Optum (UnitedHealth Group), from 28 July 2026.
- [Optum internship](/tech): Software Engineer Intern, Technical Development Program, Summer 2025. Ranked 1st in the Ireland/India cohort and Global Runner-up among 300+ interns across 6 countries; secured a Pre-Placement Offer, which converted to the full-time role.
- [Smart Notes Platform (code)](https://github.com/AlakhsimarSingh/smart_notes_platform.git): A full-stack, AI-native personal knowledge base with real-time collaboration (Yjs/Hocuspocus), a hybrid RAG chat pipeline (Groq + Cohere reranking), local semantic embeddings, and a 3D knowledge graph.

## Research (Machine Learning)

- [Research profile](/research): Machine learning research in neuroimaging, fMRI, and computer vision, with research interests, publications (BibTeX available), and project figures.
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=7nPhgUYAAAAJ): Publication and citation profile.
- [Jhana meditation fMRI classification (arXiv:2602.13008)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13008): "Machine Learning-Based Classification of Jhana Advanced Concentrative Absorption Meditation Using 7 Tesla Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging" — Kumar, Yang, Singh, Li, Sacchet. Harvard Medical School / MGH. Under review at PLOS Biology.
- [LiDAR snow-pole detection (code)](https://github.com/AlakhsimarSingh/RangeModalitiesProject): "On the Role of Range in LiDAR-Based Snow-Pole Detection: A Principled Study of Modality Fusion" — Tiwari, Singh, Rafiq, Singh, Seipel, Bavirisetti. Accepted at ICECER 2026, Istanbul, Türkiye.
- [Network vs ROI brain connectivity (code: DBCATS)](https://github.com/MIntelligence-Group/DBCATS): "Network vs ROI Perspectives: Brain Connectivity Analysis using Complex Principal Component Analysis" — Kumar, Singh, Li, Keilholz, Schumacher. Georgia Institute of Technology research internship; poster accepted at CNS 2025 (34th Annual Computational Neuroscience Meeting, OCNS), Florence, Italy.
- [VisioPhysioENet (arXiv:2409.16126)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.16126): "VisioPhysioENet: Visual Physiological Engagement Detection Network" — Singh (first author), Goyal, Verma, Kumar, Li, Singh. Multimodal engagement detection fusing visual and physiological signals for e-learning; journal version submitted to Elsevier, under peer review.
- [Multimodal engagement detection & learner privacy (research profile)](/research): First-author book chapter in "The Dark Side of AI: Privacy Invasions and Data Vulnerabilities."

- [Freelance profile](/freelance): Full-stack client work, case studies, and demo builds.
- [Maan Travels — live site](https://www.maantravels.com): Production full-stack booking platform for a luxury chauffeur service, replacing a legacy PHP site. Passwordless device-trust authentication; Lighthouse 19/75/82/85 → 99/100/100/91.
- [Maan Travels — code](https://github.com/AlakhsimarSingh/maan_travels.git): Next.js 15, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Supabase implementation.
- [NUMEN — live store](https://www.invitedsonly.com): Production streetwear and accessories e-commerce platform with 1500+ products, Razorpay card/UPI payments with server-side verification, multi-currency pricing, weight- and destination-aware shipping, and an Excel-style admin bulk editor.
- [NUMEN — code](https://github.com/AlakhsimarSingh/numen-store): Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Zustand, Supabase implementation.
